title.en: Chapter 12 — The Serpent and the Board

book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.en: All day, I thought.

sentences.ar: الحية بتيجي بالليل، وبتبلع اللي بتوصله.
sentences.en: The snake comes at night, and swallows whoever it reaches.

sentences.ar: ما بقدر أهرب منها، وما بقدر أقاتلها.
sentences.en: I cannot flee it, and I cannot fight it.
But I can prevent it from reaching me.

sentences.ar: جمعت ألواح خشب من الطوف اللي رماه الموج عالشط.
sentences.en: I gathered planks from the raft the waves had thrown on the shore.
And ropes from the trees.
And I made myself a box.

sentences.ar: لوح تحتي، ولوح فوقي، ولوح على كل جهة.
sentences.en: A plank beneath me, a plank above, a plank on each side.
Tied with the ropes, and I in the middle.

sentences.ar: وربطت الصندوق بجذع الشجرة، عشان الحية ما تدحرجه.
sentences.en: And I tied the box to the trunk of the tree, so the snake could not roll it.

sentences.ar: ودخلت فيه قبل الغروب، وسكرت آخر لوح، واستنيت.
sentences.en: And I got inside before sunset, closed the last plank, and waited.
And night came, and the snake came.
I heard it slithering around the box.

sentences.ar: وبعدين حسيت فيها بتلف حواليه، وبتعصر.
sentences.en: And then I felt it winding around it, and squeezing.

sentences.ar: الخشب صرّ، والحبال شدت، وأنا جوا، مكوم زي الجنين.
sentences.en: The wood creaked, the ropes strained, and I inside, curled like an unborn child.

sentences.ar: وحاولت تفوت راسها من كل جهة، وما لقت مكان.
sentences.en: And it tried to push its head in from every side, and found no opening.

sentences.ar: وضلت طول الليل تلف وتعصر وتفح.
sentences.en: And all night it kept winding and squeezing and hissing.
And I kept saying: Lord, the wood.
Let the wood hold.

sentences.ar: ومع أول ضو، فكت حالها، وراحت.
sentences.en: And with the first light, it uncoiled, and went.

sentences.ar: طلعت من الصندوق، وأنا أرجف، وركضت عالشط.
sentences.en: I came out of the box, shaking, and ran to the shore.
And I saw a distant ship.
I shouted, lit a fire, waved a branch.
And they saw me, sent a boat, and took me.

sentences.ar: ولما حكيت لهم قصة الحية، ما صدقوا.
sentences.en: And when I told them the story of the snake, they did not believe.
But the captain said: believe him.
I have seen wonders in this sea.

sentences.ar: وقال لي: عندي بضاعة لتاجر مات من سنين.
sentences.en: And he said to me: I have goods of a merchant who died years ago.
Sell them and take your wage.
And I asked him: what was his name?
He said: Sindbad.
We left him on an island, by mistake, asleep.
It was my ship from the second voyage.

sentences.ar: وبكى القبطان لما عرفني، ورجعت على بغداد ببضاعتي وأرباحي.
sentences.en: And the captain wept when he knew me, and I returned to Baghdad with my goods and my profits.
